about_short_description.short_description: Reditus Space specializes in microgravity manufacturing, offering reusable small-scale re-entry vehicles for space research and production.

product.name: ENOS Spacecraft
product.description: A reusable free-flying reentry spacecraft that transports payloads to low Earth orbit, supports in-space operations, and returns experiments or manufactured products to Earth.

identifier.value: Orbital Payload Launch and Integration Services

product.name: Orbital Payload Launch and Integration Services
product.description: End-to-end services for preparing and delivering customer payloads to orbit, including payload and vehicle integration, launch coordination, licensing, and mission operations.

product.name: Autonomous Orbital Operations
product.description: In-orbit operation, monitoring, and management of the ENOS spacecraft and customer payloads during the planned mission duration.

product.name: Controlled Reentry and Payload Recovery
product.description: A service that performs controlled spacecraft reentry, pinpoint landing, and recovery of the ENOS vehicle and customer payloads for return to Earth.

product.name: Microgravity Manufacturing Services
product.description: Access to microgravity for research and production processes involving crystal formation, drug formulation, optical communications materials, and semiconductor-related manufacturing.

product.name: High-Hypersonic Environment Testing
product.description: Access to Mach 28-plus atmospheric reentry conditions for testing and refining aerospace and defense systems using real-world hypersonic flight data.
